result.reason: The addition is targeted and preserves the existing provisions, but it does not reliably reach even the fallback. The 90-day Site-conformance warranty runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery, acceptance, or completion, so it may expire before the Site is delivered. The professional-and-workmanlike services warranty also lacks the required 30-day or 90-day post-performance duration. Although appropriate remedies, legal compliance, and malicious-code protection are included, the duration and trigger defects are material. The new provision should also be designated as subsection (c).
